name: jd-sku-image-fetch
description_zh: 批量抓取京东商品主图与关键指标（标题、价格、累计评价数、营销活动），按榜单批次分目录归档，输出带嵌入缩略图的 Excel。自带一键安装（setup.bat）与环境自检（doctor.py），用户不需要懂命令行。
description_en: Batch-fetch JD product main images plus key metrics (title, price, review count, promotions), archived per ranking-list batch, with an embedded-thumbnail Excel report. Ships with a one-click installer and a self-check so non-technical users need no command line.
author: 流星
